GTDSAOZG High Flow Replacement Tube, with Tube Cleaner Brush, for Hydration Reservoirs (Latest New)
 ➤Features:

items.label: High Flow Replacement Tube
items.value: This kit comes with a high flow water tube, providing a smooth and steady water flow for optimal hydration during outdoor activities.

items.label: Tube Cleaning Brush Included
items.value: Includes a flexible long cleaning brush specifically designed for the inside of the tube. With its length, it ensures thorough cleaning and easy maintenance.

items.label: Compatible Brands
items.value: This replacement tube is compatible for hydration reservoirs from all major brands, making it a versatile choice for users with different reservoirs.

items.label: Perfect Size
items.value: With a tube length of 98cm and a diameter of 1cm, this replacement tube offers the perfect balance between reach and flow rate, convenient water access without compromising performance.

items.label: Perfect Fit
items.value: This replacement tube is compatible with most hydration bladders, ensuring a secure, leak-free connection

items.label: Flexible long cleaning brush
items.value: with matching length to fully clean the inside of the tube

items.label: Practical Accessory
items.value: This replacement tube can achieve efficient water flow and is suitable for outdoor activities such as hiking, cycling, running, etc. It is a must-have for outdoor sports enthusiasts

items: GTDSAOZG High Flow Replacement Tube, with Tube Cleaner Brush, for Hydration Reservoirs (Latest New)
